confidence_notes: Restaurant, coffee and beer anchors rest on aggregated Numbeo-based figures for Pisa (Numbeo and Expatica, snapshot around June 2026): inexpensive meal about €16-18, mid-range meal for two about €71, cappuccino about €1.85, domestic draught beer €6.00-6.25. I converted these to USD at roughly 1.16 USD per EUR, which is my own assumption and not a searched rate. Cocktail and wine are weaker. I found no reliable Pisa glass-of-wine price. I used an unconfirmed menu listing of Tuscan house wine at €6-7 and the local beer price relationship, which gave about €5 per glass. For cocktails I used Italian spritz benchmarks of about €6-10, a low-reliability Expatistan Pisa figure of €6, and the beer relationship, which gave about €8.50. Accommodation anchors are holistic estimates from general knowledge for a July peak-season window. I did not search accommodation prices or inspect any listings. Hostel, 1-star and 3-star figures are the least certain.
comparable_city_reasoning: Pisa is a mid-sized Tuscan university and tourist city. Its restaurant prices are close to the Italian average, and its beer price is relatively high. Accommodation is benchmarked loosely against Florence-area secondary cities, so it is cheaper than Florence but pushed up by Leaning Tower tourism in summer.
